CLEAR_STATUS - clear_status

Clears ADC_OVERFLOW, SDCARD_DONE, SDCARD_OVERFLOW status flags

CLEAR_F1_FULL - Clear Status Fx Full

Resets the status Fx_FULL register

CLEAR_F0_FULL - Clear Status Fx Full

RESET_WRITE_HEAD - reset_write_head

Resets the write head position back to F0_START_ADDR
